semantics.bp_convergence: diagnostic only; never a logical-failure gate
semantics.logical_failure: terminal physical winding, or decoder flux_union_logical_failure on a decoded nonterminal record
semantics.omitted: all per-trajectory physical errors, observations, corrections, BP messages, and timings
semantics.resume: resume deterministic sampling at next_trajectory_index using the manifest seed_salt; merge by integer addition of counts and append non-overlapping batches
semantics.uncertainty: Wilson intervals use binomial attempted-history counts. Batches are retained only for drift/correlation diagnostics, not required for IID binomial intervals.

metadata.claim_boundary: R6Y plus R6X can support a finite-size flux-crossing estimate only after their combined multi-size curve and 40-vs-160 matched stability test are analyzed. It is not the paper's full two-stage D4 threshold.

inference_accounting: matched 40-vs-160 iteration sensitivity at the selected crossing neighborhood
scan_design.stage_2_selection_rule: Combine R6Y with R6X and allocate matched increments only at p_X values whose adjacent-size BP 90% risk-difference interval contains zero, and their immediate p_X neighbors, until signs resolve or the cap is reached.
